svg.title: Feedback: capture, acceptance and later collection
svg.desc: The first send freezes the envelope; retries retain its ID and contents. Acceptance does not mean every attachment, business-evidence job or notification is complete. Inspect collection status. The independent webhook waits for complete/partial/failed collection and also runs after collection failure. Close releases recording, polling and previews.
svg.metadata: flowchart TB A["prepare: freeze and redact the scene"] B["User reviews, masks and adds evidence"] C["submit: freeze envelope; persist report and jobs"] D["Return acceptance receipt"] E["Browser flush: resume remaining uploads"] F["Server collect: business evidence and bounded retries"] G["Record complete / partial / failed"] H["Independent webhook: send and retry by policy"] X["Submission fails: keep draft and show failure"] A --> B B --> C C --> D C -->|"not durably accepted"| X D --> E C -->|"independent background job"| F E --> G F --> G G --> H classDef default fill:#edf3ff,stroke:#476aab,color:#172b4d,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef good fill:#e9f6ef,stroke:#28734e,color:#17452f,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef stop fill:#fff0f0,stroke:#af4040,color:#742b2b,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef pending fill:#fff6df,stroke:#a07827,color:#654b18,stroke-width:1.5px; class X stop; class D,G,H pending;

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC,Noto Sans CJK JP,sans-serif
